comment: C-first positional correction for the monster-versus-monster Purple Worm AD_DGST mission. The original frozen Purple Worm recipe remains unchanged and records only Purple Worm monster-to-hero gulpmu. This recipe changes the creation action, not the seed: cmd.c wizgenesis honors a count prefix; read.c create_particular_parse sets quantity to 1 + gm.multi; create_particular_creation calls makemon for each requested monster at the hero square, and makemon chooses an available adjacent tile. The C map after creation must establish the worms’ actual adjacency. Count a helper only if C records movemon_singlemon -> fightm -> mattackm with AT_ENGL/AD_DGST -> gulpmm -> mdamagem -> mhitm_adtyping -> mhitm_ad_dgst. The movement/conflict eligibility and actual attacker/defender order will be verified from C; this recipe is not asserted to reach that branch before recording.
